title: Schéma directeur de l'éducation et de la formation 2021-2035
publisher: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale et de la Formation Professionnelle (MENFOP)
why_not: Describes the current SIGE as the OPAD/ED-ASSIST census tools behind the yearbook, not updated since 2011, and plans a pupil-tracking platform; a census description that neither states learner records are on paper nor gives a fact on a learner-record system in use.
